_comment: Spec §4.3 on-device / authoring confidence weights. Policy: 'named OR officially recognized (DOC-matched / inside conservation land) => keep (high); anonymous urban footways, private, abandoned, and informal paths => drop (low)'. Tuned against the real NZ pilot (354,985 trails): ~7% high, ~93% low, dominated by unnamed access=yes footways (sidewalks) that now score ~35. Base is deliberately LOW (30) so an unknown trail is not trusted by default; a name or official backing is what lifts it. Loaded by the authoring build (dev-only) and mirrored by ScoringWeights.default in TrailScoring.swift; the two test suites pin these exact numbers.
